title: Delete or archive the dead Story-15.13 content-upload pipeline (tool/seed_content.dart, tool/seed_text_content.dart, tool/upload_to_firebase.{js,sh})
why: None of these 4 files appear anywhere in the Makefile (grep confirms only seed_content_db.dart and validate_seed_coverage.dart are wired in); docs/linear-status.md:167 shows the feature they serve, 'DNI-121 | 15.13: Cloud Content Storage & Multilingual Fetch', as Canceled; and the in-app consumer of the Firebase Storage path they write to (CloudContentServiceProvider in lib/features/content_browsing/presentation/providers/cloud_content_providers.dart) has zero callers outside its own generated .g.dart file. The bucket name they target ('torah-study-tracker.firebasestorage.app') matches the real production bucket in lib/firebase_options.dart:53, so anyone who trusts the still-present usage comments and re-runs this chain writes real, unused data into the production Storage bucket that ST-1 already flags as having no committed security rules. upload_to_firebase.js and upload_to_firebase.sh have also already drifted from each other while unmaintained: the .sh version supports --dry-run/--curriculum=X, the .js version has no argument parsing at all and always uploads everything for real.
recommendation: Delete tool/seed_content.dart, tool/seed_text_content.dart, tool/upload_to_firebase.js, tool/upload_to_firebase.sh (or move them to a tool/_archive/ with a header banner citing DNI-121/Canceled if the team wants to keep them as reference). Update docs/explainers/content-database.md's 'Where the code lives' list and docs/api-contracts.md:92, which both still cite these files as active pipeline components.
acceptance_criteria: tool/seed_content.dart, tool/seed_text_content.dart, tool/upload_to_firebase.js, tool/upload_to_firebase.sh no longer exist at HEAD, or each carries a header stating they are retired (Story DNI-121, Canceled) and naming any current replacement
docs/explainers/content-database.md and docs/api-contracts.md:92 no longer list these files as active build-pipeline components
grep -rL 'DNI-121\|retired' over any files kept returns empty
